name: sort_sample_titles
status: Illustrative design exercise; no connected service is provided
purpose: Sort three fictional project titles into alphabetical order for an adult learning demonstration
preconditions: Use only the supplied fictional list
review: Compare input and output; confirm every title appears once and no title was changed
failure: Return an understandable error for an item that is not text; do not guess the intended value
recovery: Retain the original list and revise the contract before another attempt
